name: Folo - AI RSS Reader
subtitle: Your news & blogs, summarized
promotionalText: Let AI read first: instant summaries, side-by-side translations and read-aloud for the articles, videos and podcasts you follow, all in one calm timeline.

ai.promotionalText: Get the gist of any article in seconds, read foreign news side by side with an AI translation, and turn hundreds of new entries into one quick digest.

media.promotionalText: Podcasts, video channels and photo feeds in one timeline, each with a layout made for it. Short on time? Have any article read aloud with natural voices.

rss.promotionalText: Follow any RSS, Atom or JSON feed, plus thousands of RSSHub routes for sites without one. Import your OPML and keep everything in sync on every device.
